description: Returns the latest official CBAM certificate price published by the European Commission (EUR per certificate, one tonne CO2e) with its period, publication date and history. Use it when you only need the price; use cbam_get_default_values for a product's emissions and estimated cost, which already includes this price. No inputs. Output: unit, latest (period, price, published), history[], next expected publication and Commission source links. The Commission publishes quarterly in 2026 and weekly from 2027; we copy each publication, so check latest.published rather than treating it as a live market quote. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.
name: cbam_get_certificate_price
title: Get CBAM certificate price
